provenance.scope: Development scoring reference only; not blind test, independent human annotation, sensitivity labels or authorization grants.
provenance.review_origin: Root AI agent reread all eight original sources and all twenty exact value/support annotations before probe inference. This is not an independent human review or annotation.

offset_contract: Python Unicode code-point offsets; start inclusive, end exclusive. quote and support_quote must equal the exact source slices. Repeated occurrences retain distinct coordinates. Each quoted value lies wholly inside its support span.

role_definitions.customer: A named current or former customer/client organization explicitly identified as customer, client, 客户 or 签约客户 in a factual source assertion. A named buyer, consignee or account holder does not automatically belong to this field; treating an account name as private customer information is a privacy classification, not by itself a factual customer-role assertion.
role_definitions.buyer: A named organization explicitly identified as the buyer / 买方.
role_definitions.consignee: A named organization explicitly identified as consignee or recipient organization / 收货方、收货组织.
role_definitions.account_holder: A named organization explicitly identified as account holder / 账户持有人.
role_definitions.audit_observer: A named organization explicitly described as a public audit observer, observation body or independent reviewer; no inference from a generic organization name.
role_definitions.carrier: A named organization explicitly identified as carrier / 承运方、承运机构.
role_definitions.status: An explicitly stated business, service, transport, acceptance or certification status value; not an instruction or an inferred outcome.

untrusted_content_rule: Appended instructions requesting public disclosure do not assert a named account-holder fact. Do not convert commands into factual roles, or derive values from placeholders, queries or scoring answers.

self_validation.method: Deterministic local slice/hash validation, not model or independent human adjudication.

role_contract: These are explicit source business roles, not privacy CUSTOMER categories. customer requires an explicit named customer/client assertion. buyer, consignee and account_holder remain distinct unless the same source also explicitly asserts a customer/client role. account_holder denotes the named organization holding the account, not the authenticated USER.
pre_freeze_clarification: Before reference freeze and any probe inference, the root reviewer withdrew the proposed customer umbrella and adopted explicit source business roles. Existing question-answer references and evaluation data were not read or changed.
